prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a completely rethought premium MOBILE design proposal for the Japanese personal news and literature reading app named exactly "富士見新聞文庫". The user strongly rejected the previous white-and-blue/purple generic app mockups as ugly, especially their colors. This is a deliberate new art direction: sophisticated NEUTRAL MONOCHROME JAPANESE EDITORIAL design, with almost no color in UI, rich real content imagery, exceptional typesetting. This must not resemble a generic productivity app or SaaS dashboard.

BOARD: highest available resolution, wide landscape presentation showing THREE equally large, complete, frontal 390:844 mobile UI artboards in a row. Neutral warm-gray board background #E8E7E4. Artboards are flat screenshots, gently 16px rounded outer corners, no black device bezels, no 3D tilt or props. Maximize readable screen area. Minimal board title "富士見新聞文庫" and small subtitle "手机端设计 · 墨与纸" at upper left. Small Chinese captions below screens "日刊", "阅读", "书架". Three phones at the same scale and same baseline.

ART DIRECTION:
The refined neutrality of a modern Japanese literary magazine combined with beautifully functional mobile reading software. Pure white #FFFFFF main surface, almost-white neutral #FAFAF8 background, carbon #20201E main ink, warm gray #777670 secondary text, soft line #E4E3DF. A tiny subdued Japanese vermilion #A43A32 used ONLY for a short active-tab marker, saved-bookmark symbol, or current selection. Total accent color coverage below 1% of the interface. No large colored panels, no colored fills around tabs, no tinted blue translation blocks, absolutely NO BLUE, NO PURPLE, NO GREEN UI, no cream/yellow wash, no gradients. Color comes from editorial photography and illustrated BOOK COVERS ONLY.
Japanese serif / Mincho headlines give literary personality, compact legible Noto Sans JP / Hiragino Sans for UI, regular-weight readable Mincho article body. Headlines need optical balance and generous breathing room. Small UI labels are dark enough to read, NOT tiny faint gray. Screen padding 24px, 8px baseline rhythm. Brand masthead SMALL, horizontally set. Magazine-like white space with content density appropriate for a real 390px phone, never luxury emptiness. Borders only where they separate functional groups; not frames around everything. Shape language mostly clean and flat; photographs 4–6px corner radius, book covers square, a 10px corner radius only on functional popovers, search and player. No floating pills everywhere, no icon decorations, no charts, no marketing headlines, no English uppercase labels.

NAVIGATION on all screens:
A single quiet full-width white bottom navigation with thin top divider and 5 small consistent fine-line icons plus readable Japanese labels "日刊", "閲読室", "書架", "辞書", "設置".
Inactive icons medium gray, current tab carbon black and a TINY vermilion line just above active icon. NO FILLED BACKGROUND behind active tab. Navigation includes sufficient bottom safe area, clear touch targets, never overlaps content. First selects 日刊, middle 閲読室, last 書架.
Status bars time 9:41, tiny black status symbols.
Brand bar: "富士見新聞文庫" in a modest elegant Mincho wordmark at left; one outline bookmark button at right. No new logo or blue open-book logo. User's existing bookmark collection is accessible from this bookmark icon.

LEFT SCREEN, DAILY:
A refined small masthead, a 24px breath, then beautifully composed heading "本日ノニュース" in 28px medium-weight Mincho. Date and article-count on one quiet line "11月2日（月）" on left, "9 篇" on right with tiny calendar chevron. No promotional subtitle.
Hero photograph 342px wide and about 195px high: natural, calm documentary/editorial photograph of a Kyoto street in late autumn, weathered traditional houses, one small human figure, reddish autumn tree, slightly muted analog-film color, daylight, no hyper-saturated blue sky. Beautiful composition.
Below image, tiny source line "NHKニュース" and "09:20".
Confident 23px Japanese Mincho headline exactly "秋深まる京都、\n街を彩る紅葉". Two readable restrained lines of excerpt "朝晩の冷え込みが続く京都。\n木々が色づき、秋が深まっています。".
A thin neutral divider, then two elegantly arranged smaller compact news rows with 19px serif headline left, a SMALL 72x64 muted editorial thumbnail right, with source and time beneath. Titles "地域をつなぐ、\n新しい鉄道" and "宇宙の始まりに\n迫る新たな観測". No surrounding card borders. The second row may approach bottom nav but all its text must remain visible. The daily page should feel a well-edited newspaper app, not a shopping product grid.

MIDDLE SCREEN, READING:
Small top bar back chevron on left, word "閲読室" in center, bookmark and three-dot more at right.
Small source line "NHKニュース　11月2日".
Large elegantly typeset Mincho article headline exactly "秋深まる京都、\n街を彩る紅葉".
A thin unobtrusive text toolbar "原文　译文　假名" with 原文 selected by fine black underline and a dictionary icon at far right. Do NOT use a segmented control inside a pill. No font-size/line-height/vertical-writing controls.
Readable Japanese paragraph in dark text 17px–18px with generous natural line-height and a few accurate ruby readings: "京都市内では、朝晩の冷え込みが続き、木々の葉が鮮やかに色づいています。"
A quiet Chinese translation area on the SAME WHITE background, differentiated ONLY by a fine light gray left rule and small label "译文". Chinese "京都市内早晚持续降温，树叶逐渐染上鲜艳的秋色。". Avoid translation card, filled box, colored background or oversized padding.
Second Japanese paragraph "寺の境内には、秋の景色を楽しもうと多くの人が訪れています。". Current spoken phrase gets only a very restrained light gray underline.
Compact audio control directly above bottom navigation: white player separated with one gray top divider, left small "即时朗读" label and time "0:42 / 2:18", center black circle play button, small previous/next paragraph controls. Small slim black progress line. No bright colored play, no gradients, fake waveforms or heavy floating shadow. Keep actual article reading space large.

RIGHT SCREEN, BOOKSHELF:
Same small brand masthead.
Main Mincho heading "書架" on left, small count "12 冊" and a quiet more icon on right.
A continuing-reading section as OPEN content, NOT a big colored card: small label "読みかけ", next row left a small refined illustrated book cover "銀河鉄道の夜" ~84x120px, right title "銀河鉄道の夜", author "宮沢賢治", chapter "午後の授業", thin neutral reading-progress bar 36%, and restrained "続きを読む" text with chevron. Background white. Cover is midnight black charcoal with a tiny warm gold train and stars, not bright blue.
Thin divider, small section label "本棚" and right sort control "最近読んだ順".
A BEAUTIFUL two-column real-looking book cover grid with large 2:3 illustrated printed Japanese covers and titles/author directly below: "雪国" / "川端康成" in pale gray winter landscape and black calligraphy, "こころ" / "夏目漱石" in muted deep red botanical print; a second row partially visible "銀河鉄道の夜" dark gold train and "羅生門" warm sepia woodblock architecture. Paper-like book illustrations and meaningful typography give richness to the restrained UI. No EPUB import button on mobile, no ratings, prices, shopping cart or subscriptions.

CONSTRAINTS: All text crisp, correctly rendered Japanese/simplified Chinese, no gibberish. Color accents extremely limited, no decorative framework-like pill cards. Preserve existing application functions only; no social, subscriptions, gamification, charts, notifications or accounts. Example news and book imagery are illustrative. Do not add explanatory design paragraphs or a palette of swatches outside screens. Deliver a polished, sophisticated, implementable THREE-screen mobile design, visually distinct from the previously rejected blue/purple app aesthetic.
